image.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: mobile hairstyling education case image, a clean 2x2 comparison sheet with no text
Primary request: create four consistent observational salon photographs of the same fictional adult East Asian woman showing her current hairstyle and one current low-tie action; this is not a before-and-after transformation
Scene/backdrop: plain warm light gray salon wall, uncluttered, identical background in every panel
Subject: same adult woman in all four panels, natural unretouched skin, calm neutral expression, simple muted sage-green crew-neck top; complete head, hairline, neck and both shoulders visible
Hair: dark brown collarbone-length hair, medium overall density; softly centered-to-slightly-off-center part; mostly straight and smooth through crown and sides, with a subtle irregular S-bend more visible underneath and at the nape; continuous moderately full perimeter, long face-framing pieces that reach below the cheekbone; no bangs, no dramatic layers, no styling-product shine
Composition/framing: 2x2 grid with equal panels and thin neutral gutters. Panel 1 straight front view with hair loose. Panel 2 true side profile with hair loose, ear partly visible naturally. Panel 3 direct back view with hair loose, showing the full hemline and nape. Panel 4 rear three-quarter view of the same woman gathering the current hair into a low ponytail at the nape with a plain dark elastic; a few natural shorter edge strands may remain but do not exaggerate. Keep camera height, distance, clothing, facial identity, hair color and apparent length consistent across all panels.
Lighting/mood: soft even daylight-balanced studio light, honest salon consultation photography, realistic hair texture and flyaways, no beauty filter
Constraints: one adult only; same identity and hairstyle across all four panels; current condition only; no transformation, no scissors, no tools, no labels, no measurements, no arrows, no watermark, no logos; show full head, haircut bottom edge, neck and both shoulders in every relevant panel; the low pony is only a reversible demonstration of the current hair, not proof of future cut behavior
Avoid: glamour editorial styling, exaggerated volume, curled ends, perfect mirror symmetry, face reshaping, retouching, high ponytail, bun, braid, accessories other than one plain dark elastic, cropped crown, cropped shoulders, text
